$comment: Engine ownership registry (docs/audits/ARGUS_POST_MIGRATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md, ARGUS_JAVA_ENGINE_ACTIVATION_PLAN.md Phase 1). Classifications below are derived from that audit's source/build/runtime evidence, not invented. Regenerate this file's entries only after re-verifying against real source/tests - never hand-wave a status. Status values: NODE_AUTHORITATIVE, JAVA_AUTHORITATIVE, JAVA_ADVISORY, PARITY_SHADOW, NODE_ONLY, JAVA_ONLY, DEPRECATED_CANDIDATE. javaAuthoritative for every entry below is false - nothing in this codebase has ever reached that status; do not flip it without the Phase 8 authoritative-mode work and a real soak.

atr.javaLocation: SymbolState.tickRangeAtr (tick-range approximation, NOT equivalent to Node's)
atr.liveConsumer: Node only - Java's version is a disclosed, non-equivalent approximation

quantModels.$comment: status is the real, formalized promotion ladder (src/server/config/modelRegistry.ts is the validating loader + rules, not just this comment): RESEARCH -> BACKTEST -> WALK_FORWARD -> SHADOW (running continuously against real live/replay data, output observed/logged, zero decision influence) -> PAPER -> VALIDATED -> PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE, plus terminal DEPRECATED/DISABLED reachable from any non-terminal rung. Promotion is strictly one rung at a time (modelRegistry.ts's isValidPromotion enforces this in code, not just narratively) and is always a reviewed edit to this file, never a live/automatic toggle. No model here has ever been promoted past SHADOW - VALIDATED/PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE require real backtest+walk-forward+paper-soak evidence that does not exist yet for any of these.
quantModels.$outputTypeComment: outputType formally separates Directional Alpha Providers (produce a signed side that may feed QuantEnsembleEngine) from Conditioning/Volatility Modifiers (produce structural context - regime, variance - used only to scale/gate an ensemble result downstream via RegimeVolatilityOverlay, never to vote themselves) from infra/portfolio-risk inputs. Forcing a Conditioning Modifier into a directional vote would corrupt the ensemble - see RegimeVolatilityOverlay.java's own header.

hmm_regime.liveConsumer: JavaQuantAdvisoryService.ts (advisory event only); also feeds RegimeVolatilityOverlay.apply() as the regime input; also ChiefTraderAgent.ts loadJavaInstitutionalDebateContext() (2026-09-04) folds it into the debate prompt as text-only context - still NOT wired to EvidenceAggregator/consensus vote counting

factor_composite.liveConsumer: JavaQuantAdvisoryService.ts (advisory event only); also ChiefTraderAgent.ts loadJavaInstitutionalDebateContext() (2026-09-04) folds it into the debate prompt as text-only context - still NOT an emitTradeIdea vote, still NOT wired to EvidenceAggregator/consensus vote counting; Phase 3 (a real vote) remains gated on the migration blueprint's multi-week clean-divergence soak, not yet run

stat_arb.liveConsumer: NONE - needs a pair-selection strategy before any caller can use it; deliberately out of scope for JavaQuantAdvisoryService's initial single-symbol loop

market_data_quality.liveConsumer: FeaturePipeline.build() (gates every feature snapshot), called live via JavaQuantAdvisoryService.ts

feature_pipeline.liveConsumer: JavaQuantAdvisoryService.ts (advisory event only, not wired to ChiefTrader/EvidenceAggregator)

volatility_engine.liveConsumer: Same responses JavaQuantAdvisoryService.ts already consumes via fetchInstitutionalVolatility/fetchInstitutionalRegime; realizedVolatility also feeds RegimeVolatilityOverlay.apply() as the volatility input

market_regime_engine.httpEndpoint: NONE YET - unit-tested only, no HTTP endpoint added this pass (the additive volatility fields were exposed directly through the existing regime/volatility handlers instead of a separate combined endpoint)

correlation_engine.liveConsumer: NONE - inherently cross-symbol (needs 2+ aligned return series), deliberately out of scope for JavaQuantAdvisoryService's single-symbol loop; a TS caller (fetchInstitutionalCorrelation) exists and is tested but unused

quant_ensemble.liveConsumer: NONE - a TS caller (fetchInstitutionalEnsemble) exists and is tested but unused; deliberately NOT auto-fed from garch/regime/factor in JavaQuantAdvisoryService yet, since GARCH's volatility forecast has no honest BUY/SELL direction to contribute - only regime (BULL/BEAR_TRENDING) and factor (signed composite) have real directional content, and picking which models feed this ensemble is its own design decision, not yet made

regime_volatility_overlay.javaLocation: RegimeVolatilityOverlay.java (scales/gates a QuantEnsembleEngine result using regime suitability + inverse-volatility-targeting - both explicit, reviewed, declared assumptions pending real per-regime backtested evidence, not measured values)
regime_volatility_overlay.liveConsumer: NONE - a TS caller (fetchInstitutionalAdvisory) exists and is tested but unused

quantModels.$batchComment: The following entries (Two-Sigma-style strategy catalog expansion) are unit-tested only against synthetic/deterministic data this pass - no BACKTEST/WALK_FORWARD/PAPER evidence exists for any of them yet, hence status RESEARCH throughout, and none has an HTTP endpoint or any live/advisory consumer wired. Building the http/consumer wiring, then real historical backtests, is future work, not implied by this registration.

residual_return.javaLocation: ResidualReturnEngine.java (serves both residual momentum and residual mean-reversion catalog items via the same OLS-residual decomposition)

seasonality_effects.javaLocation: SeasonalityEffectsEngine.java (day-of-week + turn-of-month only - intraday-open/close and holiday effects are documented as NOT implemented, not approximated)

decision_tree_regressor.javaLocation: ml/DecisionTreeRegressor.java (real CART; single tree implementation shared by RandomForest and GradientBoosting below)

linear_svm.javaLocation: ml/LinearSvm.java (Pegasos algorithm - linear kernel, not a full SMO/kernel solver)

vector_autoregression.javaLocation: VectorAutoregression.java (VAR(p), one real OLS equation per series)

arima_model.javaLocation: ArimaModel.java (differencing wrapper over ArmaModel; SARIMA deliberately NOT implemented - documented gap, not approximated)

kalman_filter.javaLocation: KalmanFilter.java (general scalar linear-Gaussian filter, configurable for local-level or AR(1)-latent-state use)

egarch.javaLocation: EgarchEngine.java (real leverage-effect asymmetric volatility model, distinct from GarchEngine)

factor_exposure.javaLocation: FactorExposureEngine.java (beta, idiosyncratic volatility, Amihud illiquidity - wraps ResidualReturnEngine's OLS rather than re-deriving beta)

mean_variance_optimizer.javaLocation: MeanVarianceOptimizer.java (closed-form Markowitz min-variance + tangency portfolios). ADVISORY/RESEARCH ONLY - never sizes a real order; PositionSizing.ts remains sole sizing authority.

risk_parity_optimizer.javaLocation: RiskParityOptimizer.java (damped multiplicative-update iteration - a real 2-asset oscillation bug was found and fixed with damping during this implementation, see the class's own header). ADVISORY/RESEARCH ONLY.

volatility_targeting.javaLocation: VolatilityTargetingEngine.java. ADVISORY/RESEARCH ONLY - a sizing SUGGESTION only, never calls PositionSizing.ts or places an order.

value_at_risk.javaLocation: ValueAtRiskEngine.java (real historical VaR/Expected-Shortfall + parametric VaR via Acklam's inverse-normal-CDF approximation)

sarima.javaLocation: SarimaModel.java (seasonal ARIMA - real Hannan-Rissanen extension with seasonal AR/MA terms + seasonal differencing; fills the SARIMA gap ArimaModel's own header originally left open)

dcc_garch.javaLocation: DccGarchEngine.java (multivariate GARCH via Engle's real two-step DCC estimation)

dynamic_factor_model.javaLocation: DynamicFactorModel.java (Stock-Watson principal-components DFM - real PCA + AR dynamics on the leading factor, not a Kalman-filter joint estimation)

risk_engine_24_gates.notes: No Java equivalent exists anywhere. Must never move - safety-critical (CLAUDE.md protected architecture).

broker_adapters.notes: quant-core-java has zero broker imports/credentials by design - verified by source inspection each audit pass.

chief_trader_consensus.notes: EvidenceAggregator/ChiefTraderAgent have no Java counterpart. Any future Java evidence source must enter here as ONE vote among many, never an auto-approval - see Phase 3 of the activation plan, deliberately NOT implemented yet. Distinct from the debate-prompt TEXT context garch/hmm_regime/factor_composite feed as of 2026-09-04 (ChiefTraderAgent.ts loadJavaInstitutionalDebateContext) - that is advisory text only, never a vote, never touches this consensus math.

full_argus_replay_engine.notes: The Historical Evaluation replay UI/API path - reuses real TS ChiefTrader/RiskEngine/OMS math.

java_backtest_engine.notes: Standalone, separately tested, NOT wired to or cross-validated against the two Node engines. Do not treat its output as comparable evidence until a parity test exists.
